extracted_concepts.name: Sample Space
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Set Ω of all possible outcomes of a random experiment.

extracted_concepts.name: Countable Additivity
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Probability of disjoint union equals sum of probabilities.

extracted_concepts.name: Random Variable
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Function X:Ω→ℝ assigning numbers to outcomes.

extracted_concepts.name: Binomial Distribution
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Discrete distribution B(n,p) for binomial trials.

extracted_concepts.name: Probability Density Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Nonnegative f with integral 1 for continuous variables.

extracted_concepts.name: Function of Random Variables
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Distribution of Y=g(X) via CDF or transformation.

extracted_concepts.name: Marginal Distribution
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Distribution of one variable obtained by integrating joint density.

extracted_concepts.name: Law of Large Numbers
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Sample mean converges to population mean.

extracted_concepts.name: Student's t Distribution
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Distribution for t statistic with normal data.

extracted_concepts.name: F Distribution
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Distribution of ratio of independent chi-square variables.

extracted_concepts.name: Confidence Interval
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Interval estimate with specified confidence level.

extracted_concepts.name: Hypothesis Testing
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Decision procedure comparing H0 and H1.

extracted_concepts.name: Test Statistic
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Quantity computed from sample for testing.

extracted_concepts.name: Rejection Region
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Set of statistic values leading to rejecting H0.

extracted_concepts.name: Significance Level
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Probability of Type I error, α.
